intro: Sentinel Farsong is a night elf sentinel stationed at Silverwing Grove in Ashenvale. Serving as a crucial liaison for the Silverwing Sentinels, she coordinates intelligence and combat efforts against the encroaching Warsong Outriders in Warsong Gulch.

p: Standing vigil within Silverwing Grove, Sentinel Farsong is deeply involved in the defense of Ashenvale's southern border. With the Warsong clan continuously harvesting lumber and pushing deeper into ancestral night elf territories, she mobilizes Alliance champions to strike at Warsong Outriders and ensures field reports reach Silverwing command. Her duties center on rallying volunteers to check the Horde's territorial expansion and preserve the sacred woods.
